votes.motion: Recess into executive session under M.G.L. Chapter 39, §23B(3) to discuss collective bargaining or litigation strategy.
votes.quote: recessed by roll call vote at this time for executive session to discuss strategy with respect to collective bargaining or litigation

votes.motion: Approve the Earth Removal Permit Renewals under Bylaw Article IX, Section 9, per the inspection report.
votes.quote: steve motion to approve, tom seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Forward information on the MMA 6th grade essay contest to the school department so the town can participate.
votes.quote: board voted unimously to forward information to the school department so that the town could participate in the annual contest.

votes.motion: Accept the Town Counsel fee for general services and cap it at $36,000.
votes.quote: motion to accept the fee for general services and cap at $36,000 move by tom, seconded by steve voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Issue a Proclamation declaring October 24, 2010 as United Nations Day.
votes.quote: entertain a motion that we issue a proclamation declaring october 24, 2010 as united nations day, steve moved tom seconded, voted unanimously.
being no further business board voted unanimously to adjourn regular session at 8:43 p.m.
